task.title: Add editable web board mutations
task.description: Extend the local web board from read-only viewing to safe task editing. Start with drag-and-drop status changes between workflow columns, then add simple field edits only if they fit cleanly through the same core service as the CLI. Preserve JSON/error semantics, create normal Workbook operation commits, and keep the server loopback-only unless hosting/auth is explicitly designed.
